title: Grok research-source bot with citation and provenance capture
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Problem

Research-source transcripts need a controlled capture path with intact citations and provenance. Grok can help find and synthesize candidate sources, but its narrative is not classifier truth.

## Scope

- Add a configurable OpenRouter Grok research-source adapter, defaulting to x-ai/grok-4.1-fast.
